basic_info.description: Best Buy in Parkside! Gorgeous & Exceptional! Fully Detached Home in the Desirable Parkside Neighborhood! This residence spans 3-split levels, offering 2,040 SQFT of living space, plus 265 SQFT bonus attic finished space, 3BD/3BA and sits on 4,200 SQFT huge lot. Fully remodeled from studs, all-new electrical and new plumbing, done with permits. Step inside to discover elegant White Oak hardwood floors, an open & airy layout with abundant natural light. The main level features a sun-drenched living room with fireplace, sleek kitchen with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, wet bar, wine cooler, wall wine racks, large central island, dining area, breakfast area and 2BD/2BA, including a primary suite with en-suite bath. A spiral staircase leads to the attic and expansive roof deck, offering sweeping  ocean views. Additional highlights include washer/dryer hookups, tankless water heater, EV charging outlet and tandem parking for three cars in the driveway. The lower level features a family room, 3rd bedroom with en-suite bath, & direct access to large backyard, ideal for barbecues, family gatherings, or outdoor relaxation. Located near restaurants, shops, grocery, top-ranked schools, MUNI transit, Farmers Market, Lakeshore Plaza, Lake Merced, Ocean Beach, and more. A must see!
